title: Unfinished Business
description: A spirit is lingering in Dalhurst - lingering, not undead, and I want the word used precisely. It was not torn from the cycle; it is held by something unfinished. Find what it left behind and it will pass on its own.

objectives.description: Travel to Dalhurst to investigate the haunting
Speak to the innkeeper about the ghost
Find the ghost's locket in the old house
Place the locket at the ghost's grave
Return to the Priest of Morthane

notes: Threat: named specifically as the doctrinal category, not the ghost's grief - a lingering soul, not an undead abomination, which is the whole point Morthane's priest wants understood. Giver motive: teaching the distinction is the actual lesson, not the locket errand. Consequence: not wired. Known duplicate of the root file morthane_restless_soul, deliberately differentiated - this copy is the temple's doctrinal concern (what kind of dead this is); the root copy is a townsman's grief (the widow who receives the ghost's message).
